content: {"like": ["The set includes a \"play all\" function."],"dislike": ["Poor packaging design that looks like a book but contains nine small cardboard folders floating around the box.","Discs fall out easily and one disc was missing.","Difficulty storing the set.","Inability to locate the \"contact Amazon\" link.","Hassle involved with returning the product, especially for someone with GBS.","The \"play all\" function does not allow repeating the entire disc.","Commentary tracks are unhelpful and feel like eavesdropping on a personal viewing party."]}
